On the way it passes Donat, Chur and Flims. The highest point is about 2,150 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Albula Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 4 km this is Albula Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
